output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the mintedAmount parameter, which is added to the balanceOf mapping without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the _value parameter, which is added to the balanceOf mapping without a check, allowing the user to cause an integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, leading to a complete loss of funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the _value parameter, which is added to the balanceOf mapping without a check, allowing the user to cause an integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, leading to a complete loss of funds.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the amount variable, which is set to msg.value / buyPrice, buyPrice can be manipulated by an attacker to overflow the amount variable, causing a denial of service.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the amount * sellPrice, sellPrice can be manipulated by an attacker to overflow the amount variable, causing a denial of service.
